fields.description: The HIKVision gateway's recordList CSV export (sName, sJobNo, sCard, Date, Time, IN/OUT, ReadID, EventMainCode, EventSubCode, AttendanceStatus, WearMask, SerialNo, ClockStation). Locked once this import is submitted.
fields.label: HIKVision CSV File

fields.description: Checkins always use the employee's own Branch (from their Employee record). This is only a fallback for employees who have no Branch set at all. Leave blank to require every employee in the file to have their own Branch.
fields.label: Fallback Branch

fields.description: Not Parsed: no file attached yet. Missing Information: file parsed but some employee codes/branches don't resolve. Pending Import: everything resolves, ready for Start Import. Importing: the background job is running. Completed: submitted. Error: the background job failed after being queued - see Import Log.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Not Parsed
Missing Information
Pending Import
Importing
Completed
Error

fields.description: Employees appearing in this file with no Branch on their own Employee record, and no Fallback Branch set above to cover them. Set a Branch on these Employees, or set a Fallback Branch, to clear this.
fields.label: Employees Without a Branch

fields.description: Every employee code in the file that couldn't be matched to an Employee. Assign an Employee to each row and save - this both clears the issue and permanently records the mapping on that Employee, so future imports resolve it automatically. Submitting is blocked while any issue remains unresolved.
fields.label: Issues
